fig1_confusion_matrix.caption: Row-normalised confusion matrix of the plain byte-CNN on the Dataset V4 test split, summed over 3 training seeds (41,262 fragment evaluations). Most off-diagonal mass is PDF fragments predicted as ZIP or JPG.

fig2_precision_recall.caption: Per-class precision against recall (error bars: seed std) with iso-F1 contours, and per-class F1. PDF has high precision but the lowest recall; ZIP and JPG lose precision to the PDF fragments they absorb.

fig3_fragment_confidence_timeline.caption: Per-fragment calibrated confidence across three files. A mostly-correct PDF with three low-confidence ZIP fragments; a PDF whose majority vote flips to ZIP; and an XML file read as HTML.

fig4_dataset_class_distribution.caption: Dataset V4 class balance. The per-class cap keeps every class near an equal share; CSV falls short because its sources ran out of usable files. Panel (b) shows which real corpus supplied each class.

fig5_training_curves.caption: Accuracy after each epoch on the 10% split carved from train.npz, which train.py uses to keep the best epoch (band: seed std); and the NT-Xent loss during E_full's contrastive pre-training. train.py records no per-epoch training-set accuracy, so no train-vs-validation curve is shown.

fig7_pdf_container_analysis.caption: PDF container analysis. (a) For one PDF, stream objects parsed from its bytes against the per-fragment predictions. (b) Every GovDocs1 PDF fragment in the V4 test split, each byte-verified against its source file and grouped by the stream type holding most of its bytes: ZIP predictions concentrate in FlateDecode data and JPG predictions in DCTDecode data.

fig8_pipeline_architecture.caption: FragGen inference pipeline and ByteCNN architecture. Layer sizes, parameter counts, the calibration temperature and the ablation hyper-parameters are read from the checkpoint, the calibration file and configs/real.yaml, not typed by hand.

fig6_ablation_comparison.caption: Validation and test accuracy and test macro-F1 for the cumulative ablation ladder on Dataset V4. Annotations give the seed-paired difference from A_plain and its Holm-adjusted p-value.
